```typescript
  /**
   * 检测操作类型
   */
  private detectOperationType(userInput: string): string {
    const patterns = {
      'activate_emergency': [/紧急|危机|故障|修复/, /activate.*emergency|emergency.*mode/i],
      'neural_decision': [/神经|决策|智能决策/, /neural.*decision|decision.*making/i],
      'industry_analysis': [/行业|分析|市场/, /industry.*analysis|market.*research/i],
      'multimodal_creation': [/多模态|内容创作|生成/, /multimodal|content.*creation|generate.*content/i],
      'iot_control': [/物联网|设备|控制/, /iot|device.*control|smart.*device/i],
      'nonyi_ecommerce': [/非遗|文化|电商/, /cultural.*heritage|nonyi|ecommerce/i],
      'quantum_optimization': [/量子|优化/, /quantum.*optimization|optimize.*quantum/i],
      'scenario_processing': [/场景|处理/, /scenario.*processing|process.*scenario/i],
      'career_classification': [/职业|分类/, /career.*classification|classify.*career/i],
      'create_workflow': [/创建.*工作流|工作流.*创建/, /create.*workflow|workflow.*create/i],
      'execute_workflow': [/执行.*工作流|工作流.*执行/, /execute.*workflow|workflow.*execute/i],
      'generate_workflow': [/生成.*工作流|自动.*生成/, /generate.*workflow|auto.*generate/i],
      'auto_repair': [/自动.*修复|修复.*自动/, /auto.*repair|repair.*auto/i],
      'process_luoyang_heritage': [/洛阳|非遗|文化/, /luoyang.*heritage|cultural.*luoyang/i],
      'train_model': [/训练.*模型|模型.*训练/, /train.*model|model.*training/i],
      'validate_parameters': [/验证.*参数|参数.*验证/, /validate.*parameters|parameter.*validation/i]

    for (const [operation, patternList] of Object.entries(patterns)) {
      for (const pattern of patternList) {
        if (pattern.test(userInput)) {
          return operation;

    return 'unified_execute'; // 默认统一执行

  /**
   * 执行操作
   */
  private async executeOperation(operationType: string, request: UniversalRequest): Promise<any> {
    switch (operationType) {
      // ========== 紧急处理相关 ==========
        return await this.activateEmergencyMode(request.operation_config?.emergency_config);
        return await this.autoRepair(request.operation_config?.repair_config);
      case 'repair_all_nodes':
        return await this.repairAllNodes(request.operation_config?.repair_config);
      case 'backup_revert':
        return await this.backupRevert(request.operation_config?.backup_config);

      // ========== AI增强相关 ==========
      case 'ai_enhancement':
        return await this.aiEnhancement(request.operation_config?.ai_enhancement_config);
      case 'train_model':
        return await this.trainModel(request.operation_config?.training_config);
      case 'feed_data':
        return await this.feedData(request.operation_config?.training_config);

      // ========== 工作流管理相关 ==========
      case 'create_workflow':
        return await this.createWorkflow(request.operation_config?.workflow_config);
      case 'execute_workflow':
        return await this.executeWorkflow(request.operation_config?.workflow_config);
      case 'update_workflow':
        return await this.updateWorkflow(request.operation_config?.workflow_config);
      case 'delete_workflow':
        return await this.deleteWorkflow(request.operation_config?.workflow_config);
      case 'get_workflow_by_id':
        return await this.getWorkflowById(request.operation_config?.workflow_config);
      case 'get_workflows':
        return await this.getWorkflows(request.operation_config?.query_config);
        return await this.generateWorkflow(request.operation_config?.workflow_config);

      // ========== 自定义节点相关 ==========
      case 'create_custom_node':
        return await this.createCustomNode(request.operation_config?.custom_node_config);
      case 'trigger_auto_plugin_workflow':
        return await this.triggerAutoPluginWorkflow(request.operation_config?.plugin_config);

      // ========== 行业分析相关 ==========
      case 'analyze_industry':
        return await this.analyzeIndustry(request.operation_config?.industry_config);
        return await this.industryAnalysis(request.operation_config?.all_scenario_config);

      // ========== 文化遗产相关 ==========
      case 'process_luoyang_heritage':
        return await this.processLuoyangHeritage(request.operation_config?.heritage_config);
      case 'nonyi_ecommerce':
        return await this.processNonyiEcommerce(request.operation_config?.all_scenario_config);

      // ========== 全场景智能自动化特有功能 ==========
      case 'neural_decision':
        return await this.neuralDecision(request.operation_config?.all_scenario_config);
      case 'multimodal_creation':
        return await this.multimodalCreation(request.operation_config?.all_scenario_config);
      case 'iot_control':
        return await this.iotControl(request.operation_config?.all_scenario_config);
      case 'quantum_optimization':
        return await this.quantumOptimization(request.operation_config?.all_scenario_config);
      case 'scenario_processing':
        return await this.scenarioProcessing(request.operation_config?.all_scenario_config);
      case 'career_classification':
        return await this.careerClassification(request.operation_config?.all_scenario_config);

      // ========== 自动化处理相关 ==========
      case 'process_automation':
        return await this.processAutomation(request.operation_config?.automation_config);
      case 'get_data_connections':
        return await this.getDataConnections(request.operation_config?.connection_config);

      // ========== 验证相关 ==========
      case 'validate_parameters':
        return await this.validateParameters(request.operation_config?.validation_config);

      // ========== 统一执行 ==========
      case 'unified_execute':
        return await this.unifiedExecute(request);

  // ==================== 具体功能实现 ====================

  /**
   * 激活紧急模式
   */
  async activateEmergencyMode(config: any): Promise<any> {
    const emergencyLevel = config?.emergency_level || 'critical';
    const reason = config?.activation_reason || '系统检测到异常';
    
    // 执行紧急操作
    await this.securityManager.activateEmergencyProtocol(emergencyLevel, reason);
    
    // 记录紧急事件
    await this.backupManager.createEmergencyBackup();
    
    // 发送通知
    await this.sendEmergencyNotifications(config?.notification_contacts);
    
      status: 'emergency_activated',
      level: emergencyLevel,
      reason: reason,
      actions_taken: ['安全协议激活', '紧急备份创建', '通知发送'],

  /**
   * 自动修复
   */
  async autoRepair(config: any): Promise<any> {
    const repairType = config?.repair_type || 'system';
    const diagnosisLevel = config?.diagnosis_level || 'comprehensive';
    
    // 执行诊断
    const diagnostics = await this.performDiagnostics(diagnosisLevel);
    
    // 执行修复
    const repairs = await this.performRepairs(diagnostics, repairType);
    
      status: 'repair_completed',
      diagnostics: diagnostics,
      repairs_applied: repairs,
      success_rate: this.calculateRepairSuccessRate(repairs),

  /**
   * AI数据增强
   */
  async aiEnhancement(config: any): Promise<any> {
    const inputData = config?.input_data;
    const enhancementType = config?.enhancement_type || 'quality_improvement';
    const dataType = config?.data_type || 'text';
    
    // 调用AI服务进行数据增强
    const enhancedData = await this.aiService.enhanceData({
      type: enhancementType,
      data_type: dataType,
      quality_threshold: config?.quality_threshold || 0.8
    
      status: 'enhancement_completed',
      original_data: inputData,
      enhanced_data: enhancedData,
      quality_improvement: this.calculateQualityImprovement(inputData, enhancedData),

  /**
   * 创建工作流
   */
  async createWorkflow(config: any): Promise<any> {
    const workflowName = config?.workflow_name || '未命名工作流';
    const nodes = config?.nodes || [];
    const description = config?.description || '';
    
    // 创建工作流定义
    const workflow: WorkflowDefinition = {
      id: this.generateWorkflowId(),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: 'draft',
      created_by: 'system',
      nodes: nodes,
      connections: config?.connections || [],
      triggers: config?.triggers || [],
      variables: config?.variables || [],
      settings: this.initializeWorkflowSettings(config),
      permissions: this.initializeWorkflowPermissions(config),
      metadata: this.initializeWorkflowMetadata(config),
      tags: config?.tags || [],
      category: config?.business_domain || 'general'
    
    // 保存工作流
    this.workflows.set(workflow.id, workflow);
    
    // 验证工作流
    const validation = await this.validateWorkflow(workflow);
    
      status: 'workflow_created',
      workflow_id: workflow.id,
      validation_result: validation,
      creation_time: new Date().toISOString()

  /**
   * 统一执行
   */
  async unifiedExecute(request: UniversalRequest): Promise<any> {
    // 分析用户输入
    const analysis = await this.analyzeUserInput(request.user_input);
    
    // 根据分析结果选择最佳执行路径
    const executionPlan = await this.createExecutionPlan(analysis, request);
    
    // 执行计划
    const results = await this.executePlan(executionPlan);
    
      status: 'unified_execution_completed',
      user_input: request.user_input,
      execution_plan: executionPlan,

  // ==================== 辅助方法 ====================

  private validateRequest(request: UniversalRequest): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    
    if (!request.user_input || request.user_input.trim() === '') {
      errors.push('user_input不能为空');
    
    if (typeof request.enable_automation !== 'boolean') {
      errors.push('enable_automation必须是布尔值');
    
      errors: errors


  private generateWorkflowId(): string {
    return `wf_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;

  private async analyzeUserInput(userInput: string): Promise<any> {
    // 使用AI服务分析用户输入
    return await this.aiService.analyzeIntent(userInput);

  private async createExecutionPlan(analysis: any, request: UniversalRequest): Promise<any> {
    // 创建执行计划
      steps: this.determineExecutionSteps(analysis),
      resources: this.allocateResources(analysis),
      optimization_strategy: this.selectOptimizationStrategy(request),
      fallback_plan: this.createFallbackPlan(analysis)

  private async executePlan(executionPlan: any): Promise<any> {
    const results: any[] = [];
    
    for (const step of executionPlan.steps) {
        const result = await this.executeStep(step);
          step: step.name,
        
        // 执行回退计划
        if (executionPlan.fallback_plan) {
          const fallbackResult = await this.executeFallbackPlan(executionPlan.fallback_plan, step);
            step: `${step.name}_fallback`,
            status: 'fallback_executed',
            result: fallbackResult

  private async validateWorkflow(workflow: WorkflowDefinition): Promise<any> {
    
    // 检查节点
    for (const node of workflow.nodes) {
      if (!node.id || !node.name) {
        errors.push(`节点缺少必要字段: ${node.id || '未命名节点'}`);
    
    // 检查连接
    for (const connection of workflow.connections) {
      if (!connection.source_node_id || !connection.target_node_id) {
        errors.push('连接缺少必要字段');
    
      connection_count: workflow.connections.length
```

```python
            # 1. 验证请求

    def detect_operation_type(self, user_input: str) -> str:
        """检测操作类型"""
            'activate_emergency': [r'紧急|危机|故障|修复', r'activate.*emergency|emergency.*mode'],

        user_input_lower = user_input.lower()
        
        for operation, pattern_list in patterns.items():
            for pattern in pattern_list:
                if re.search(pattern, user_input_lower, re.IGNORECASE):
                    return operation
        
        return 'unified_execute'  # 默认统一执行
    
    async def execute_operation(self, operation_type: str, request: UniversalRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """执行操作"""
        operation_config = request.operation_config or {}
        
        if operation_type == 'activate_emergency':
            return await self.activate_emergency_mode(operation_config.get('emergency_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'neural_decision':
            return await self.neural_decision(operation_config.get('all_scenario_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'multimodal_creation':
            return await self.multimodal_creation(operation_config.get('all_scenario_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'iot_control':
            return await self.iot_control(operation_config.get('all_scenario_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'quantum_optimization':
            return await self.quantum_optimization(operation_config.get('all_scenario_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'nonyi_ecommerce':
            return await self.nonyi_ecommerce(operation_config.get('all_scenario_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'scenario_processing':
            return await self.scenario_processing(operation_config.get('all_scenario_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'career_classification':
            return await self.career_classification(operation_config.get('all_scenario_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'process_luoyang_heritage':
            return await self.process_luoyang_heritage(operation_config.get('heritage_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'create_workflow':
            return await self.create_workflow(operation_config.get('workflow_config', {}))
        elif operation_type == 'unified_execute':
            return await self.unified_execute(request)
            # 其他操作类型
            return await self.execute_legacy_operation(operation_type, operation_config)

                    'step': step.get('name'),

                    fallback_result = await self.execute_fallback_plan(fallback_plan, step)
                        'step': f"{step.get('name')}_fallback",
                        'status': 'fallback_executed',
                        'result': fallback_result

        # 检查节点
            if not node.id or not node.name:

            'valid': len(errors) == 0,

            'warnings': warnings,
```

        await asyncio.gather(*init_tasks)

    async def process_request(self, request: UserRequest) -> ProcessingResult:
        处理用户请求 - 完整流程
        1. 认证验证 → 2. 意图识别 → 3. 功能路由 → 
        4. 执行处理 → 5. 结果整合 → 6. 输出生成
        
            # 步骤1: 认证验证
            auth_result = await self.components["security"].authenticate(request)
            if not auth_result["authenticated"]:
                return ProcessingResult(
                    message="认证失败",
                    automation_level=AutomationLevel.MANUAL,
                    processed_request=request.user_input,
                    detected_intent="unknown",
                    auto_selected_functions=[],
                    automation_results={},
                    authentication_status=auth_result,
                    performance_metrics={"processing_time": time.time() - start_time}
            
            # 步骤2: 意图识别
            intent_result = await self.components["automation"].analyze_intent(
                request.user_input
            
            # 步骤3: 功能路由
            routing_result = await self.components["automation"].route_functions(
                intent_result, request
            
            # 步骤4: 并行执行
            execution_results = await self._execute_functions(
                routing_result["selected_functions"],
                request
            
            # 步骤5: 结果整合
            integration_result = await self.components["automation"].integrate_results(
                execution_results, intent_result
            
            # 步骤6: 生成最终输出
            final_result = await self._generate_final_output(
                integration_result,
                request,
                auth_result,
                start_time
            
            # 记录性能指标
            await self.components["monitor"].record_processing(
                operation="unified_automation",
                duration=time.time() - start_time,
                success=True
            
            
            logging.error(f"处理请求失败: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
            
            # 记录错误
            await self.components["monitor"].record_error(
                error=str(e),
                error_type=type(e).__name__
            
                message=f"处理失败: {str(e)}",
                detected_intent="error",
                authentication_status={},
                performance_metrics={"processing_time": time.time() - start_time},
                repair_report=f"错误详情: {str(e)}\n建议: 检查输入格式，联系技术支持"
    
    async def _execute_functions(self, functions: List[str], request: UserRequest) -> Dict:
        """并行执行功能函数"""
        function_map = {
            "json_repair": self.components["json_repair"].repair_json,
            "mcp_generation": self.components["mcp_generator"].generate_server,
            "plugin_creation": self.components["plugin_generator"].generate_plugin,
            "workflow_automation": self.components["workflow_engine"].generate_workflow,
            "ai_training": self.components["ai_trainer"].train_model,
            "data_processing": self.components["data_feeder"].feed_data,
            "validation": self.components["validator"].validate_parameters
        
        for function_name in functions:
            if function_name in function_map:
                task = function_map[function_name](request.user_input)
        
        # 并行执行所有任务
            results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
            
            # 处理结果
            execution_results = {}
            for i, (function_name, result) in enumerate(zip(functions, results)):
                if isinstance(result, Exception):
                    execution_results[function_name] = {
                        "error": str(result)
                    execution_results[function_name] = result
            
            return execution_results

    async def _triple_authentication(self, request: UserRequest) -> Dict:
        """执行三重认证"""
        
        # API密钥认证
        api_key = request.context.get("api_key")
        if api_key:
            results["api_key"] = await self._validate_api_key(api_key)
        
        # Bearer Token认证
        bearer_token = request.context.get("bearer_token")
        if bearer_token:
            results["bearer_token"] = await self._validate_bearer_token(bearer_token)
        
        # OAuth 2.0认证
        oauth_token = request.context.get("oauth_token")
        if oauth_token:
            results["oauth2"] = await self._validate_oauth2(oauth_token)
        
    
    async def _validate_api_key(self, api_key: Optional[str]) -> Dict:
        """验证API密钥"""
        if not api_key:
            return {"valid": False, "error": "API密钥为空"}
        
        # 检查格式
        if len(api_key) < 32:
            return {"valid": False, "error": "API密钥格式无效"}
        
        # 检查是否有效（实际应用中应查询数据库）
        if api_key in self.api_keys:
            key_info = self.api_keys[api_key]
            if key_info.get("enabled", True):
                    "valid": True,
                    "permissions": key_info.get("permissions", []),
                    "expires_at": key_info.get("expires_at")
        
        return {"valid": False, "error": "API密钥无效"}
    
    async def _validate_bearer_token(self, token: Optional[str]) -> Dict:
        """验证Bearer Token"""
        if not token:
            return {"valid": False, "error": "Token为空"}
        
        # 检查缓存
        if token in self.token_cache:
            cached = self.token_cache[token]
            if cached["expires_at"] > datetime.datetime.now():
                return cached
        
        # 验证JWT Token（简化版）
            # 实际应用中应使用jwt库验证
            if token.startswith("eyJ"):  # 简单的JWT格式检查
                # 解码和验证
                
                parts = token.split(".")
                if len(parts) == 3:
                    # 解码payload
                    payload = json.loads(base64.b64decode(parts[1] + "===").decode())
                    
                    # 检查过期时间
                    exp = payload.get("exp")
                    if exp and exp < time.time():
                        return {"valid": False, "error": "Token已过期"}
                    
                        "user_id": payload.get("sub"),
                        "scopes": payload.get("scope", "").split(),
                        "expires_at": datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(exp) if exp else None
                    
                    # 缓存结果
                    self.token_cache[token] = result
            logging.error(f"Token验证失败: {str(e)}")
        
        return {"valid": False, "error": "Token无效"}
    
    async def _validate_oauth2(self, token: Optional[str]) -> Dict:
        """验证OAuth 2.0 Token"""
            return {"valid": False, "error": "OAuth Token为空"}
        
        # 简化版的OAuth验证

            if token.startswith("oauth_"):

                    "token_type": "bearer"
            logging.error(f"OAuth验证失败: {str(e)}")
        
        return {"valid": False, "error": "OAuth Token无效"}
    
    def _determine_security_level(self, results: Dict) -> str:
        """根据认证结果确定安全级别"""
        valid_count = sum(1 for result in results.values() if result.get("valid", False))
        
        if valid_count == 3:
            return "enterprise"
        elif valid_count == 2:
            return "enhanced"
        elif valid_count == 1:
            return "standard"
            return "none"
    
    def _calculate_security_score(self, results: Dict) -> int:
        """计算安全评分"""
        base_score = 0
        
        for result in results.values():
            if result.get("valid", False):
                if "permissions" in result:
                    base_score += 30
                elif "scopes" in result:
                    base_score += 35
                elif "client_id" in result:
                    base_score += 40
        
        return min(base_score, 100)

class IntentRecognizer:
    """意图识别器"""
    
        self.intent_patterns = self._load_intent_patterns()
    
    async def analyze(self, text: str) -> Dict:
        """分析用户意图"""
        
        # 检测主要意图
        primary_intent = "general"
        confidence = 0.5
        detected_keywords = []
        
        for intent, patterns in self.intent_patterns.items():
                if pattern in text_lower:
                    primary_intent = intent
                    confidence = 0.8
                    detected_keywords.append(pattern)
        
        # 检测紧急程度
        urgency_keywords = ["紧急", "立刻", "马上", "尽快", "重要", "优先"]
        urgency_score = sum(1 for keyword in urgency_keywords if keyword in text)
        priority = 5 + min(urgency_score * 2, 5)  # 5-10的优先级
        
            "primary_intent": primary_intent,
            "confidence": confidence,
            "keywords": detected_keywords,
            "priority": priority,
            "complexity": self._assess_complexity(text)
    
    def _assess_complexity(self, text: str) -> str:
        """评估复杂度"""
        word_count = len(text.split())
        
        if word_count > 100:
            return "complex"
        elif word_count > 50:
            return "simple"
    
    def _load_intent_patterns(self) -> Dict:
        """加载意图模式"""
            "repair": ["修复", "错误", "问题", "改正", "修正", "debug", "fix", "error"],
            "generate": ["创建", "生成", "制作", "建立", "开发", "create", "generate", "build"],
            "train": ["训练", "学习", "模型", "AI", "人工智能", "train", "learn", "model"],
            "validate": ["验证", "检查", "测试", "确认", "校验", "validate", "check", "test"],
            "automate": ["自动化", "自动", "流程", "工作流", "automate", "workflow", "process"],
            "integrate": ["集成", "连接", "对接", "整合", "integrate", "connect", "link"],
            "optimize": ["优化", "改进", "提升", "增强", "optimize", "improve", "enhance"]

class FunctionRouter:
    """功能路由器"""
    
        self.routing_rules = self._load_routing_rules()
    
    async def route(self, intent_result: Dict, request: UserRequest) -> Dict:
        """路由到适当的功能"""
        primary_intent = intent_result["primary_intent"]
        priority = intent_result["priority"]
        
        # 根据意图选择功能
        selected_functions = self.routing_rules.get(primary_intent, ["json_repair"])
        
        # 根据自动化级别调整
        if not request.automation_enabled:
            selected_functions = ["validation"]  # 只进行验证
        
        # 根据优先级调整
        if priority > 7:
            selected_functions.append("validation")  # 高优先级任务需要验证
        
            "selected_functions": selected_functions,
            "routing_strategy": "intent_based",
            "intent": primary_intent,
            "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
    
    def _load_routing_rules(self) -> Dict:
        """加载路由规则"""
            "repair": ["json_repair", "validation"],
            "generate": ["mcp_generation", "plugin_creation", "workflow_automation"],
            "train": ["ai_training", "data_processing"],
            "validate": ["validation"],
            "automate": ["workflow_automation", "plugin_creation"],
            "integrate": ["plugin_creation", "workflow_automation"],
            "optimize": ["json_repair", "validation"],
            "general": ["json_repair", "validation", "workflow_automation"]

class ResultIntegrator:
    """结果整合器"""
    
    async def integrate(self, execution_results: Dict, intent_result: Dict) -> Dict:
        """整合执行结果"""
        successful_results = {}
        failed_results = {}
        issues_resolved = 0
        artifacts = {}
        
        for function_name, result in execution_results.items():
            if result.get("status") == "success":
                successful_results[function_name] = result
                
                # 统计解决的问题
                if "issues_fixed" in result:
                    issues_resolved += result["issues_fixed"]
                
                # 收集生成的工作产物
                if "artifacts" in result:
                    artifacts.update(result["artifacts"])
                failed_results[function_name] = result
        
        # 生成修复报告
        repair_report = self._generate_repair_report(successful_results, failed_results)
        
            "detected_intent": intent_result["primary_intent"],
            "selected_functions": list(execution_results.keys()),
                "successful": successful_results,
                "failed": failed_results
            "issues_resolved": issues_resolved,
            "artifacts": artifacts if artifacts else None,
            "repair_report": repair_report,
            "summary": self._generate_summary(successful_results, failed_results, issues_resolved)
    
    def _generate_repair_report(self, successful: Dict, failed: Dict) -> str:
        """生成修复报告"""
        report_lines = ["# Coze自动化处理报告", ""]
        
        if successful:
            report_lines.append("## ✅ 成功处理的功能")
            for func_name, result in successful.items():
                report_lines.append(f"- **{func_name}**: {result.get('message', '完成')}")
                if "details" in result:
                    for detail in result["details"][:3]:  # 显示前3个详情
                        report_lines.append(f"  - {detail}")
            report_lines.append("")
        
        if failed:
            report_lines.append("## ❌ 处理失败的功能")
            for func_name, result in failed.items():
                report_lines.append(f"- **{func_name}**: {result.get('error', '未知错误')}")
        
        report_lines.append(f"## 📊 统计信息")
        report_lines.append(f"- 总处理功能: {len(successful) + len(failed)}")
        report_lines.append(f"- 成功: {len(successful)}")
        report_lines.append(f"- 失败: {len(failed)}")
        report_lines.append(f"- 成功率: {(len(successful) / (len(successful) + len(failed)) * 100):.1f}%")
        
        return "\n".join(report_lines)
    
    def _generate_summary(self, successful: Dict, failed: Dict, issues_resolved: int) -> str:
        """生成摘要"""
        total = len(successful) + len(failed)
        success_rate = (len(successful) / total * 100) if total > 0 else 0
        
        summary = f"自动化处理完成。"
        
            summary += f" 成功执行了{len(successful)}个功能。"
        
        if issues_resolved > 0:
            summary += f" 解决了{issues_resolved}个问题。"
        
            summary += f" {len(failed)}个功能执行失败。"
        
        summary += f" 总体成功率: {success_rate:.1f}%。"

class CozeJsonRepairMaster:
    """全能JSON修复大师 - 完整实现"""
    
        self.repair_modules = {
            "syntax": SyntaxRepairModule(),
            "structure": StructureRepairModule(),
            "logic": LogicRepairModule(),
            "optimization": OptimizationModule()
    
    async def repair_json(self, input_data: str) -> Dict:
        
            # 1. 检测输入类型
            input_type = self._detect_input_type(input_data)
            
            # 2. 提取JSON内容
            json_content = self._extract_json_content(input_data, input_type)
            
            # 3. 执行多级修复
            repair_results = {}
            for module_name, module in self.repair_modules.items():
                result = await module.repair(json_content)
                repair_results[module_name] = result
                json_content = result.get("fixed_content", json_content)
            
            # 4. 验证修复结果
            validation = await self._validate_repair(json_content)
            
            
                "input_type": input_type,
                "repair_results": repair_results,
                "validation": validation,
                "fixed_content": json_content,
                "formatted_output": json.dumps(json_content, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                "import_ready": validation.get("is_valid", False),
                "processing_time_ms": round(processing_time * 1000, 2),
                "issues_fixed": sum(r.get("fix_count", 0) for r in repair_results.values()),
                "details": [f"{module}: {r.get('fix_count', 0)}个修复" 
                           for module, r in repair_results.items()]
            
                "error_type": type(e).__name__
    
    def _detect_input_type(self, text: str) -> str:
        
        if text.startswith('{') and text.endswith('}'):
            return "pure_json"
        elif text.startswith('[') and text.endswith(']'):
            return "json_array"
        elif '---' in text[:100]:  # YAML分隔符
        elif any(keyword in text.lower() for keyword in 
                ['plugin', 'node', 'workflow', 'coze']):
            return "coze_config"
        elif re.search(r'[\u4e00-\u9fa5]', text):  # 包含中文
    
    def _extract_json_content(self, text: str, input_type: str) -> str:
        """提取JSON内容"""
        if input_type == "pure_json":
        elif input_type == "yaml":
                data = yaml.safe_load(text)
        elif input_type == "coze_config":
            # 尝试提取JSON对象
            json_objects = re.findall(r'(\{[^{}]*\})', text)
            if json_objects:
                return max(json_objects, key=len)
    
    async def _validate_repair(self, content: str) -> Dict:
        """验证修复结果"""
            parsed = json.loads(content)
                "parsed_successfully": True,
                "data_type": type(parsed).__name__,
                "size_estimate": len(content)
                "is_valid": False,
                "parsed_successfully": False

class SyntaxRepairModule:
    """语法修复模块"""
    
    async def repair(self, json_str: str) -> Dict:
        
        # 修复缺失的引号
        fixed, quote_fixes = self._fix_missing_quotes(fixed)
        fixes.extend(quote_fixes)
        
        # 修复缺失的逗号
        fixed, comma_fixes = self._fix_missing_commas(fixed)
        fixes.extend(comma_fixes)
        
        # 修复括号不匹配
        fixed, bracket_fixes = self._fix_mismatched_brackets(fixed)
        fixes.extend(bracket_fixes)
        
        # 修复布尔值和null
        fixed, value_fixes = self._fix_boolean_null(fixed)
        fixes.extend(value_fixes)
        
            "fixed_content": fixed,
            "fix_count": len(fixes),
            "fixes": fixes[:10]  # 只返回前10个修复详情
    
    def _fix_missing_quotes(self, text: str) -> tuple:
        """修复缺失的引号"""
        
        # 匹配属性名但没有引号的情况
        pattern = r'([{,]\s*)([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)(\s*:)'
        
        def replacer(match):
            prefix = match.group(1)
            key = match.group(2)
            suffix = match.group(3)
            
            fixes.append({
                "type": "add_quotes",
                "key": key,
                "position": match.start()
            
            return f'{prefix}"{key}"{suffix}'
        
        fixed = re.sub(pattern, replacer, text)
        return fixed, fixes

class StructureRepairModule:
    """结构修复模块"""
    
        """修复结构错误"""
            data = json.loads(json_str)
            
            # 确保必填字段
            data, required_fixes = self._ensure_required_fields(data)
            fixes.extend(required_fixes)
            
            # 修复类型错误
            data, type_fixes = self._fix_type_errors(data)
            fixes.extend(type_fixes)
            
            # 标准化字段名
            data, naming_fixes = self._standardize_field_names(data)
            fixes.extend(naming_fixes)
            
                "fixed_content": data,
                "fixes": fixes[:10]
            
                "fix_count": 0

class LogicRepairModule:
    """逻辑修复模块"""
    
    async def repair(self, data: Any) -> Dict:
        """修复逻辑错误"""
            return {"fixed_content": data, "fix_count": 0}
        
        
        # 修复工作流节点连接
        if 'nodes' in data or 'workflow' in data:
            data, connection_fixes = self._fix_workflow_connections(data)
            fixes.extend(connection_fixes)
        
        # 修复变量引用
        data, reference_fixes = self._fix_variable_references(data)
        fixes.extend(reference_fixes)
        

class OptimizationModule:
    """优化模块"""
    
        """优化数据结构"""
        
        
        # 移除空字段
        keys_to_remove = []
            if value in ([], {}, None, ""):
                keys_to_remove.append(key)
        
        for key in keys_to_remove:
            del data[key]
            fixes.append({"type": "remove_empty", "field": key})
        
        # 排序字段
        if len(data) > 5:
            sorted_keys = sorted(data.keys())
            if list(data.keys()) != sorted_keys:
                sorted_data = {k: data[k] for k in sorted_keys}
                fixes.append({"type": "sort_fields", "old_order": list(data.keys())})
                data = sorted_data

class McpServerGenerator:
    """MCP服务器自动化生成器 - 完整实现"""
    
    
    async def generate_server(self, requirements: str) -> Dict:
        """生成MCP服务器"""
        
            # 分析需求
            analysis = await self._analyze_requirements(requirements)
            
            # 生成项目
            project = await self._generate_project(analysis)
            
            
                "project_name": analysis["project_name"],
                "project_structure": project["structure"],
                "source_code": project["code"],
                "config_files": project["configs"],
                "deployment_configs": project["deployment"],
                "requirements_analysis": analysis,
                "artifacts": {
                    "source_files": list(project["code"].keys()),
                    "config_files": list(project["configs"].keys()),
                    "deployment_files": list(project["deployment"].keys())
                "deployment_instructions": self._generate_instructions(analysis)
            
    
    async def _analyze_requirements(self, requirements: str) -> Dict:
        """分析需求"""
        # 提取关键词
        
        feature_keywords = {
            "tools": ["工具", "功能", "操作", "执行", "处理"],
            "resources": ["资源", "数据", "文件", "存储", "内容"],
            "authentication": ["认证", "登录", "权限", "安全", "授权"],
            "database": ["数据库", "存储", "SQL", "数据", "持久化"],
            "http_client": ["HTTP", "API", "网络", "请求", "调用"],
            "logging": ["日志", "记录", "监控", "追踪", "审计"]
        
        for feature, keywords in feature_keywords.items():
            if any(keyword in requirements for keyword in keywords):
                features.append(feature)
        
        # 生成项目名
        words = re.findall(r'\b(\w{3,})\b', requirements[:100])
        if len(words) >= 2:
            project_name = f"{words[0].lower()}-{words[1].lower()}-mcp-server"
            project_name = f"mcp-server-{int(time.time())}"
        
            "project_name": project_name,
            "detected_features": features,
            "requirements_text": requirements[:500]

class PerformanceMonitor:

            "processing_times": [],
            "success_rates": [],
            "error_counts": [],
            "resource_usage": []
    
    async def record_processing(self, operation: str, duration: float, success: bool):
        """记录处理性能"""
        self.metrics["processing_times"].append({
            "operation": operation,
            "duration": duration,
            "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "success": success
        
        # 保持最近1000条记录
        if len(self.metrics["processing_times"]) > 1000:
            self.metrics["processing_times"] = self.metrics["processing_times"][-1000:]
    
    async def record_error(self, operation: str, error: str, error_type: str):
        """记录错误"""
        self.metrics["error_counts"].append({
            "error": error,
    
    async def get_metrics(self) -> Dict:
        """获取性能指标"""
        if not self.metrics["processing_times"]:
            return {"status": "no_data"}
        
        times = [m["duration"] for m in self.metrics["processing_times"]]
        successes = [m["success"] for m in self.metrics["processing_times"]]
        
            "average_processing_time": sum(times) / len(times),
            "success_rate": (sum(1 for s in successes if s) / len(successes)) * 100,
            "total_operations": len(self.metrics["processing_times"]),
            "error_count": len(self.metrics["error_counts"]),
            "recent_operations": self.metrics["processing_times"][-10:]

from typing import Dict, Any, Optional

class CozeAutomationClient:
    """Coze自动化系统客户端"""
    
    def __init__(self, base_url: str = "https://api.coze.com/v1", 
                 api_key: Optional[str] = None,
                 bearer_token: Optional[str] = None):
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip('/')
        self.bearer_token = bearer_token
        
    async def unified_automation(self, user_input: str, **kwargs) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """统一自动化处理"""
        url = f"{self.base_url}/unified/automation"
        
            **kwargs
        
        headers = self._build_headers()
        
            async with session.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers) as response:
    
    async def repair_json(self, json_input: str, **kwargs) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """JSON修复"""
        url = f"{self.base_url}/coze/json/repair"
        
            "coze_json_inputs": json_input,
            **kwargs
        
        
    
    async def generate_mcp_server(self, requirements: str, **kwargs) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        url = f"{self.base_url}/mcp/server/generate"
        
            "server_requirements": requirements,
            **kwargs
        
        
    
    async def generate_plugin(self, description: str, **kwargs) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        url = f"{self.base_url}/coze/plugin/generate"
        
            "plugin_description": description,
            **kwargs
        
        
    
    async def health_check(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """健康检查"""
        url = f"{self.base_url}/system/health"
        
        
            async with session.get(url, headers=headers) as response:
    
    def _build_headers(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        """构建请求头"""
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "User-Agent": "CozeAutomationClient/1.0"
        
        if self.api_key:
            headers["X-API-Key"] = self.api_key
        
        if self.bearer_token:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.bearer_token}"
        
        return headers

scripts/deploy.py


class CozeDeployment:
    """Coze系统部署类"""
    
    def __init__(self, environment: str = "production"):
        self.environment = environment
        self.project_root = Path(__file__).parent.parent
    
    def _load_config(self) -> dict:
        """加载部署配置"""
        config_file = self.project_root / "config" / f"{self.environment}.yaml"
        
        if not config_file.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"配置文件不存在: {config_file}")
        
    
    def build_docker_image(self):
        """构建Docker镜像"""
        print("🔨 构建Docker镜像...")
        
        image_name = f"coze-automation-system:{self.environment}"
        dockerfile = self.project_root / "Dockerfile"
        
            "docker", "build",
            "-f", str(dockerfile),
            "-t", image_name,
            "."
        
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=self.project_root, capture_output=True, text=True)
        
            print(f"✅ Docker镜像构建成功: {image_name}")
            return image_name
            print(f"❌ Docker镜像构建失败: {result.stderr}")
    
    def run_tests(self):
        """运行测试"""
        print("🧪 运行测试...")
        
            "pytest",
            "tests/",
            "-v",
            "--cov=src",
            "--cov-report=term-missing"
        
        
            print("✅ 所有测试通过")
            print(f"❌ 测试失败: {result.stdout}")
    
    def deploy_kubernetes(self, image_name: str):
        """部署到Kubernetes"""
        print("☸️ 部署到Kubernetes...")
        
        # 应用配置
        k8s_dir = self.project_root / "deployments" / "kubernetes"
        
        # 更新镜像版本
        deployment_file = k8s_dir / "deployment.yaml"
        if deployment_file.exists():
            with open(deployment_file, 'r') as f:
                deployment = yaml.safe_load(f)
            
            # 更新镜像
            deployment['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image'] = image_name
            
            with open(deployment_file, 'w') as f:
                yaml.dump(deployment, f)
        
        # 应用配置
        for yaml_file in k8s_dir.glob("*.yaml"):
            cmd = ["kubectl", "apply", "-f", str(yaml_file)]
            subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
        
        print("✅ Kubernetes部署完成")
    
    def deploy_docker_compose(self, image_name: str):
        """使用Docker Compose部署"""
        print("🐳 使用Docker Compose部署...")
        
        compose_file = self.project_root / "deployments" / "docker-compose.yaml"
        
        # 更新镜像
        with open(compose_file, 'r') as f:
            compose_config = yaml.safe_load(f)
        
        compose_config['services']['coze-automation']['image'] = image_name
        
        with open(compose_file, 'w') as f:
            yaml.dump(compose_config, f)
        
        # 启动服务
        cmd = ["docker-compose", "-f", str(compose_file), "up", "-d"]
        subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=self.project_root, check=True)
        
        print("✅ Docker Compose部署完成")
    
        """执行部署"""
        print(f"🚀 开始部署Coze自动化系统 ({self.environment}环境)")
        
        # 1. 运行测试
        self.run_tests()
        
        # 2. 构建镜像
        image_name = self.build_docker_image()
        
        # 3. 根据环境选择部署方式
        if self.environment == "production":
            self.deploy_kubernetes(image_name)
            self.deploy_docker_compose(image_name)
        
        print("🎉 部署完成!")
        print(f"📊 访问地址: http://localhost:{self.config.get('server', {}).get('port', 8000)}")
        print(f"📚 API文档: http://localhost:{self.config.get('server', {}).get('port', 8000)}/docs")

    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Coze自动化系统部署脚本")
    parser.add_argument("--env", default="production", 
                       choices=["development", "staging", "production"],
                       help="部署环境")
    
    
    deployment = CozeDeployment(environment=args.env)
    deployment.run()

    ## 📊 API端点
    
    ### 主要端点：
    
    1. **POST /automation/execute** - 执行智能自动化处理
    2. **GET /automation/status/{execution_id}** - 查询执行状态
    3. **GET /automation/features** - 获取功能列表
    4. **GET /system/health** - 系统健康检查
    5. **POST /workflow/create** - 创建工作流（智能路由自动调用）

# 🏗️ 终极智能自动化超级中枢 - 统一系统架构

## 📋 项目概述

**项目名称**: 终极智能自动化超级中枢  
**统一工具**: universalAutomationExecute - 集成两大系统的单一自动化工具  
**核心特性**: 用户只需输入需求，系统自动处理所有操作，智能路由至68个功能模块  

## 🎯 核心设计原则

### 1. 完全统一原则
- **单一入口**: 所有功能通过 `/automation/execute` 统一入口
- **统一认证**: Bearer Token + JWT 统一认证机制
- **统一响应**: 标准化的JSON响应格式
- **统一错误处理**: 统一的错误代码和修复机制

### 2. 智能自动化原则
- **零配置**: 用户只需提供 `user_input` 自然语言描述
- **自动路由**: 基于神经决策系统的智能路由
- **自动参数**: 智能提取和配置所有必要参数
- **自动优化**: 基于执行反馈的持续优化

### 3. 企业级可靠性原则
- **高可用**: 多区域部署，99.99%可用性
- **可扩展**: 微服务架构，水平扩展能力
- **安全性**: 端到端加密，多重认证
- **可观测性**: 完整的监控、日志、追踪

## 🔄 统一执行流程

### 智能执行流程图
```mermaid
    participant A as API网关
    participant D as 神经决策引擎
    participant R as 智能路由器
    participant W as 工作流编排服务
    participant AI as AI增强服务
    participant S as 系统运维服务
    participant C as 结果整合器
    participant M as 监控系统

    U->>A: POST /automation/execute
    Note over U,A: {user_input: "分析电商趋势并创建工作流"}
    
    A->>D: 请求意图分析
    D->>D: 分析用户意图
    D->>R: 返回功能匹配结果
    
    R->>W: 触发工作流创建
    R->>AI: 触发AI数据分析
    R->>S: 触发系统检查
    
    par 并行执行
        W->>W: 创建工作流
        AI->>AI: 分析行业数据
        S->>S: 检查系统健康
    
    W->>C: 返回工作流结果
    AI->>C: 返回分析结果
    S->>C: 返回健康结果
    
    C->>C: 统一结果整合
    C->>M: 记录执行指标
    C->>A: 返回完整结果
    A->>U: 200 OK
    
    Note over M: 监控: 成功率, 耗时, 健康分
```


```mermaid
    B -->|是| C[返回成功结果]
    B -->|否| D[错误分类]
    
    D --> E[参数错误]
    D --> F[系统错误]
    D --> G[业务错误]
    D --> H[网络错误]
    
    E --> I[自动参数修复]
    F --> J[系统自愈机制]
    G --> K[业务逻辑调整]
    H --> L[重试机制]
    
    I --> M[重新执行]
    
    M --> N{修复成功?}
    N -->|是| C
    N -->|否| O[记录错误]
    O --> P[通知运维]
    P --> Q[人工干预]
    Q --> C
```

            # 验证请求

        """验证请求参数"""

```python
        processor = processors.get(operation_type)
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的操作类型: {operation_type}")
        
        return await processor(request.user_input, request.parameters or {})

    def _generate_suggestions(self, result: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[str]:
        """根据处理结果生成建议"""
        
        if "sentiment" in result:
            sentiment = result["sentiment"]
            if sentiment == "negative":
                suggestions.append("检测到负面情绪，建议进行情感安抚")
            elif sentiment == "positive":
                suggestions.append("积极情绪检测，可进一步引导")
        
        if "keywords" in result and result["keywords"]:
            suggestions.append(f"检测到关键词: {', '.join(result['keywords'][:3])}")
        
        if "complexity" in result:
            complexity = result["complexity"]
                suggestions.append("检测到高复杂度任务，建议分步处理")
        
        return suggestions or ["处理完成，无特殊建议"]
    
    def _generate_next_steps(self, request: ProcessingRequest, result: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[str]:
        """生成下一步建议"""
        next_steps = []
        
        if request.operation_type == OperationType.TEXT_ANALYSIS.value:
            next_steps.append("可进行情感深入分析")
            next_steps.append("可提取更多语言特征")
        
        elif request.operation_type == OperationType.DATA_PROCESSING.value:
            next_steps.append("可进行数据可视化")
            next_steps.append("可进行统计分析")
        
        elif request.operation_type == OperationType.CODE_GENERATION.value:
            next_steps.append("可进行代码测试")
            next_steps.append("可进行代码优化")
        
        return next_steps or ["任务完成，可选择其他操作类型"]

    def _format_success_response(self, response: ProcessingResponse) -> str:
        """格式化成功响应"""
        result = response.result
        
        lines = [
            "✅ 智能自动化统一处理结果",
            f"操作类型: {response.operation_performed}",
            f"处理模式: {response.mode_used}",
            f"自动化启用: {'是' if response.automation_enabled else '否'}",
            f"处理时间: {response.processing_time:.3f}秒",
            f"会话ID: {response.session_id}",
            f"时间戳: {response.timestamp}",
            "-" * 40,
            "处理结果:",
            "-" * 40
        
        # 根据操作类型格式化结果
        if response.operation_performed == OperationType.TEXT_ANALYSIS.value:
            lines.extend([
                f"原始文本: {result.get('original_text', '')[:100]}...",
                f"字数统计: {result.get('word_count', 0)}",
                f"情感分析: {result.get('sentiment', 'unknown')}",
                f"关键词: {', '.join(result.get('keywords', []))}",
                f"复杂度: {result.get('complexity', 'unknown')}"
        
        elif response.operation_performed == OperationType.DATA_PROCESSING.value:
                f"数据类型: {result.get('data_type', 'unknown')}",
                f"数据项数: {result.get('item_count', 0)}",
                f"可用字段: {', '.join(result.get('keys_available', []))}",
                f"处理摘要: {result.get('summary', '')}"
        
        elif response.operation_performed == OperationType.CODE_GENERATION.value:
                f"编程语言: {result.get('language', 'unknown')}",
                f"代码行数: {result.get('lines_of_code', 0)}",
                "生成代码预览:",
                result.get('generated_code', '')[:300] + "..." if len(result.get('generated_code', '')) > 300 else result.get('generated_code', '')
        
            # 通用格式化
            for key, value in result.items():
                if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
                    value_str = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)[:300]
                    if len(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)) > 300:
                        value_str += "..."
                    value_str = str(value)
                
                if len(value_str) > 200:
                    value_str = value_str[:200] + "..."
                
                lines.append(f"{key}: {value_str}")
        
        # 添加建议
        if response.suggestions:
                "💡 智能建议:",
            for i, suggestion in enumerate(response.suggestions, 1):
                lines.append(f"{i}. {suggestion}")
        
        # 添加下一步
        if response.next_steps:
                "📋 建议下一步:",
            for i, step in enumerate(response.next_steps, 1):
                lines.append(f"{i}. {step}")
        
            "🎉 处理成功完成!",
        
    
    def _format_error_response(self, response: ProcessingResponse) -> str:
        """格式化错误响应"""
            "❌ 处理失败",
            "错误信息:",
            response.error_message or "未知错误",
            "🛠️ 建议操作:",
            "1. 检查输入参数是否正确",
            "2. 确认操作类型是否支持",
            "3. 尝试使用不同的处理模式",
            "4. 检查enable_automation参数设置",
            "5. 联系技术支持获取帮助",
        
    
    async def run(self):
        """运行MCP服务器"""
        async with mcp.server.stdio.stdio_server() as (read_stream, write_stream):
            await self.server.run(
                read_stream,
                write_stream,
                InitializationOptions(
                    server_name="unified-automation-server",
                    server_version="2.0.0",
                    capabilities=self.server.get_capabilities(
                        notification_options=NotificationOptions(),
                        experimental_capabilities={}

# ====================== 主程序入口 ======================

    print("🚀 正在启动智能自动化统一处理平台 MCP 服务器...", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"📅 启动时间: {datetime.now().isoformat()}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"🐍 Python版本: {sys.version}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"🔧 服务器版本: 2.0.0", file=sys.stderr)
    print("-" * 60, file=sys.stderr)
    print("📋 支持的操作类型:", file=sys.stderr)
    for i, op_type in enumerate(OperationType, 1):
        print(f"  {i:2d}. {op_type.value:<20} - {op_type.name.replace('_', ' ').title()}", file=sys.stderr)
    print("✨ 功能特点:", file=sys.stderr)
    print("  ✓ 单一统一工具接口", file=sys.stderr)
    print("  ✓ 支持自动/手动/混合模式", file=sys.stderr)
    print("  ✓ 完整的错误处理和验证", file=sys.stderr)
    print("  ✓ 兼容Coze平台", file=sys.stderr)
    print("  ✓ 修复所有API错误", file=sys.stderr)
    print("✅ 服务器已启动，等待连接...", file=sys.stderr)
    print("💡 提示: 使用工具 'unified_automation_processor' 调用所有功能", file=sys.stderr)
    
    server = UnifiedAutomationMCPServer()
    await server.run()
```

```json
  "tool": "unified_automation_processor",

    "operation_type": "text_analysis",
      "detailed_analysis": true
```

4. 支持的参数

参数名 类型 必填 说明
user_input string 是 用户输入内容
operation_type string 是 操作类型：text_analysis, data_processing, file_conversion, workflow_execution, ai_prediction, code_generation, image_processing, audio_processing, document_extraction, automated_testing
mode string 否 处理模式：automatic, manual, hybrid（默认：automatic）
enable_automation boolean 否 是否启用自动化（默认：true）
parameters object 否 处理参数，根据操作类型不同
options object 否 处理选项

修复的错误和特性

1. ✅ 修复了所有API错误：包括"Inconsistent API URL prefix"和"Invalid params"
2. ✅ 修复了JSON Schema错误：确保所有响应都是有效的JSON对象/数组
3. ✅ 单一统一工具：将所有功能整合到一个工具中
4. ✅ 完整的参数验证：确保所有参数都经过验证
5. ✅ 支持自动化开关：用户可以控制是否启用自动化处理
6. ✅ 多种处理模式：支持自动、手动、混合三种模式
7. ✅ 完整的错误处理：提供详细的错误信息和恢复建议
8. ✅ 兼容Coze平台：完全遵循Coze平台规范
9. ✅ 中文支持：完全支持中文输入和输出
